description: Angular component for a dialog used to test node scripts within the Thingsboard platform, including form handling, layout initialization, and script testing logic.

classes.name: NodeScriptTestDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for the node script test dialog, managing form state, layout, and script testing.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and pre-fills message data with beautified JSON.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up the split layout after view initialization.

methods.name: initSplitLayout
methods.description: Configures the split panels layout for the dialog.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without returning data.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Triggers script testing and formats the output.

methods.name: testNodeScript
methods.description: Performs script testing via the RuleChainService and handles errors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Submits the script for testing and closes the dialog with the script value.
